Fire Breaks Out on Air Busan Plane

A fire broke out on an Airbus A321 aircraft preparing for a flight from Gimhae International Airport to Hong Kong.

The fire occurred in the tail section of the plane. All 169 passengers and 7 crew members were safely evacuated using emergency slides. 

It was reported that three individuals sustained basic injuries, and no fatalities were reported in the incident.

🎥: YTN
